description: Expected monthly-grid paths of Korinek et al. (2026) at the paper's presets and at non-default settings, generated by running the authors' scenario-explorer model code headless as a black-box oracle. Only the resulting numbers are stored here; no code from the explorer is in this repository. Values every 3 months from 2024.0 to 2030.0, 13 significant digits. Series ids match data/core/korinek-2026-faithful.json variables; percentages are 100 x (exp(gap) - 1) except the unemployment rates, net return and labour share, which are plain percentages as in Table 3.

provenance.licence: none stated; used as an oracle only
provenance.invocation: the chunk's scenario builder with the preset keys conservative / central / fast and the overrides listed per setting (kernel key 'gamma' is xi, 'theta' is theta^H, 'muCN'/'muNC' are mu, 'psiAnchor'/'psiCeil' are psi, 'eps' is epsilon), level form 'exact', default calibration (CPS 2025 shares, IPUMS 2010-19 hazards, CPS 2010-19 matrix), horizon 2030
provenance.kernelGuards: For every setting the explorer-only guards (kappa cap 3, a ceiling ln 30, infeasible demand, negative stock) were checked not to bind; the counts are stored per setting.
